common_notes: All documents should be clear, legible, and consistent in names, dates, and signatures.
Use certified translations for any non-English or non-country-language records as required.
Prepare both scanned copies (PDF) and original hard copies for interviews/biometrics.
Keep at least one backup folder with chronologically sorted financial and academic records.

countries.name: Australia
countries.pdf_summary: This checklist is designed for students applying to Australian institutions under Subclass 500, with emphasis on Genuine Student profile quality, financial traceability, and complete enrollment evidence.

documents.name: Identity and Civil Documents
documents.description:
- Valid passport (recommended study-period validity with buffer)
- National ID/citizenship records
- Birth certificate (if required by institution or visa stage)
- Name-change or legal-status documents where records differ
- Relationship documents for dependents

documents.name: Academic Qualification Package
documents.description:
- Grade 10/12 transcripts and certificates
- Bachelor or Master transcripts and degree/provisional records
- English test score report (IELTS/PTE/TOEFL as accepted)
- Gap explanation letter with evidence
- Updated CV with academic/professional timeline

documents.name: Admission and Enrollment Evidence
documents.description:
- Offer letter and acceptance record
- CoE (Confirmation of Enrolment)
- Tuition deposit/payment receipts
- Course details and intake timeline
- Institution communications and condition-fulfillment records

documents.name: GS and SOP Readiness
documents.description:
- Genuine Student statement mapped to profile
- Course and provider selection justification
- Career pathway narrative linked to home country opportunities
- Explanation for gaps/stream changes
- Prior refusal/travel declaration where applicable

documents.name: Financial Capacity and Sponsor File
documents.description:
- 6-12 month bank statements with source clarity
- Sponsor income proof: salary/business/tax records
- Loan sanction/disbursement letter (if loan-backed)
- Affidavit of support and sponsor relationship proof
- Asset/liquidity support papers where necessary

documents.name: Health and Compliance
documents.description:
- OSHC policy for required duration
- Medical examination receipts where requested
- Police/character documents if applicable
- Declaration forms accuracy check
- Dependents health/compliance records

documents.name: Final Submission Governance
documents.description:
- Indexed e-file with logical naming
- Cross-check consistency across SOP, finances, forms
- Response-ready folder for additional document requests
- Interview preparation notes and key answers
- Backup archive of all uploaded documents

countries.name: Canada
countries.pdf_subtitle: Study Permit Preparation File (SDS and Non-SDS Aware)
countries.pdf_summary: This checklist supports strong Canadian study permit preparation with emphasis on LOA compliance, PAL/TAL scenario readiness, financial transparency (including GIC where applicable), and study rationale clarity.

documents.name: Identity and Family Information
documents.description:
- Valid passport and previous travel documents
- National identity and civil records
- Photograph set as per current IRCC specification
- Marital/family documents where relevant
- Name consistency supporting affidavits where needed

documents.name: Academic and Language Credentials
documents.description:
- Complete transcripts and certificates
- IELTS/CELPIP/TOEFL score evidence
- Gap explanation with supporting references
- Resume with clear timeline
- Program-fit evidence for course selection

documents.name: Admission and Institutional Compliance
documents.description:
- Letter of Acceptance (LOA)
- PAL/TAL support where applicable
- Tuition fee receipt and payment schedule
- Enrollment condition fulfillment records
- Deferral/transfer correspondence if intake changed

documents.name: Financial Strength and GIC Readiness
documents.description:
- 6-12 month bank statements
- Source-of-funds trail for major deposits
- GIC certificate and confirmation (if applicable)
- Sponsor income/tax/business records
- Loan sanction details and relationship proof

documents.name: SOP/Letter of Explanation Quality
documents.description:
- Progression-based study rationale
- Home-country career linkage
- Funding explanation aligned to profile
- Refusal history explanation and corrective strategy
- Ties to home country evidence

documents.name: Medical, Biometrics, and Integrity
documents.description:
- Medical exam records as instructed
- Biometrics appointment/completion records
- Police clearance where required
- Truthful refusal/travel/legal disclosure
- Dependents documentation if accompanying

documents.name: Final Study Permit File Governance
documents.description:
- Complete forms with consistency checks
- Logical upload sequence and file naming
- Fee payment confirmation records
- Additional-document response plan
- Pre-departure compliance checklist

countries.name: UK
countries.pdf_summary: This checklist is designed around UK Student Route readiness, emphasizing CAS alignment, maintenance funds compliance, and credibility-focused personal documentation.

documents.name: Identity and Travel Records
documents.description:
- Valid passport and previous passports
- Photo documents as per visa center standard
- National ID/civil status records
- Legal name-change evidence where applicable
- Dependent relationship records if needed

documents.name: Academic and English Evidence
documents.description:
- Academic transcripts and certificates
- UKVI-accepted English language proof
- Academic references and personal statement
- Gap explanation with supporting evidence
- CV for postgraduate/research profile

documents.name: CAS and University Compliance
documents.description:
- CAS statement cross-checked with profile
- Offer and acceptance records
- Tuition deposit/payment evidence
- Condition-fulfillment records for CAS issuance
- ATAS certificate where required

documents.name: Financial Maintenance Pack
documents.description:
- 28-day maintenance funds evidence
- Tuition paid and unpaid balance clarity
- Sponsor income and relationship proof
- Loan sanction/disbursement records if used
- Statement date and currency consistency checks

documents.name: Health and Character Compliance
documents.description:
- TB test certificate where applicable
- Police clearance if profile requires
- Immigration history/refusal disclosure
- IHS and fee payment records
- Dependent health documents where needed

documents.name: Credibility Interview Readiness
documents.description:
- Course and institution rationale summary
- Career outcome plan with home-country link
- Funding narrative consistency
- Typical interview question preparation
- Final document order for quick review

documents.name: Final Student Route Submission
documents.description:
- Application form review and declaration check
- Biometric appointment and upload confirmations
- Accommodation and arrival planning docs
- Emergency/support contact records
- Backup archive of all files

countries.name: United States
countries.pdf_subtitle: F-1 Visa and I-20 Readiness Portfolio
countries.pdf_summary: This checklist supports US student applicants through complete I-20, SEVIS, DS-160, and interview preparedness with strong funding and post-study intent clarity.

documents.name: Identity and Passport Records
documents.description:
- Valid passport with adequate validity
- Previous passport/travel history records
- National ID/civil records
- Name correction/legal variation documents
- Visa photo as per US specification

documents.name: Academic and Test Portfolio
documents.description:
- Official transcripts and degree certificates
- TOEFL/IELTS or accepted English tests
- SAT/GRE/GMAT where required
- SOP/personal statement and CV
- Recommendation letters and supporting portfolio

documents.name: Admission, I-20, and SEVIS Essentials
documents.description:
- Admission letter and final I-20
- SEVIS I-901 fee receipt
- Program duration and expense details
- Scholarship/assistantship letters if any
- Enrollment communications

documents.name: Financial Dossier for F-1
documents.description:
- Liquid funds proof for first-year costs
- Sponsor income/tax/employment/business records
- Bank statements and source-of-funds evidence
- Loan sanction terms where applicable
- Affidavit of support and relationship proof

documents.name: DS-160 and Visa Interview Readiness
documents.description:
- DS-160 confirmation page
- Visa fee and appointment confirmation
- Interview answer framework (study, funds, return intent)
- Home-country ties evidence
- Profile risk handling for gaps/refusals

documents.name: Compliance and Integrity
documents.description:
- Travel and refusal history transparency
- Legal/police records where applicable
- Consistency across I-20, DS-160, and interview narrative
- Dependent documents for F-2 if relevant
- Emergency contact and insurance preparedness

documents.name: Final File and Departure Readiness
documents.description:
- Structured folder order for interview
- Digital backup with searchable file names
- Tuition and housing preparation records
- Arrival and onboarding readiness docs
- Post-approval verification checklist

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.pdf_summary: This checklist is tailored for New Zealand fee-paying student visa preparation with strong emphasis on genuine intent, financial sufficiency, and complete health/character readiness.

documents.name: Identity and Civil Status Records
documents.description:
- Valid passport and civil identity records
- Photograph set per visa specification
- Name/legal correction documents where required
- Relationship records for dependent applications
- Prior travel documentation

documents.name: Academic and Language Eligibility
documents.description:
- Academic transcripts and certificates
- IELTS/PTE/TOEFL results as accepted
- Gap explanation with work/training evidence
- Resume and educational timeline
- Program prerequisite compliance records

documents.name: Offer and Tuition Evidence
documents.description:
- Offer of Place from approved provider
- Tuition payment receipts and schedule
- Condition-fulfillment communication from provider
- Program details and intake timeline
- Accommodation planning records

documents.name: Financial Sufficiency Dossier
documents.description:
- Bank statements with source clarity
- Sponsor income/tax/business documentation
- Loan sanction/disbursement where applicable
- Living-cost planning summary
- Return/onward travel financial evidence if requested

documents.name: Health and Character Requirements
documents.description:
- Medical and chest x-ray reports where required
- Police clearance certificates
- Immigration history transparency
- Health insurance records
- Dependent health/compliance support

documents.name: SOP and Genuine Intent Structure
documents.description:
- Study objective and New Zealand rationale
- Course-to-career linkage for home country
- Settlement and study-support planning
- Return intent evidence
- Prior refusal or profile-risk explanation

documents.name: Final Submission and Follow-Up Controls
documents.description:
- Indexed application bundle with clear sections
- Form/declaration consistency checks
- Payment and submission confirmations
- Response protocol for additional-document requests
- Backup archive of all records
